map.📖 查看「看涨期权盈亏平衡使用指南」: 📖 View the "Call Option Breakeven User Guide"
map.股价高于此点买方盈利。: Above this point the buyer profits.
map.卖方盈亏平衡相同但方向相反。: The seller's breakeven is the same but opposite in direction.
map.看涨期权买方到期不亏的标的价 = 行权价 + 权利金。: The underlying price at which a call buyer breaks even at expiry = strike price + premium.
map.与直接买股票的成本对比。: Compare with the cost of buying the stock directly.
map.看涨保本点 = K + 权利金 = 100 + 5 = 105。到期标的 >10: Call breakeven = K + premium = 100 + 5 = 105. At expiry, underlying > 105 buyer profits, = 105 breakeven, < 105 loss (max loss = premium 5).
map.K=100、权利金 8：保本点=108。权利金越贵，需涨越多才回本。: K=100, premium 8: breakeven = 108. The more expensive the premium, the more the price must rise to recoup.
map.买方已付权利金，需标的涨过行权价后继续覆盖这笔成本才打平。: The buyer has already paid the premium; the underlying must rise past the strike and then cover this cost to break even.
